IC1: Patients will only be included in the study if they meet all of the following criteria:
IC2: - Patient who has given informed consent
IC3: - Patient with age 18 years or older
IC4: - Patient with locally [OR] or distantly advanced breast carcinoma, [AND] with at least 1 lesion of at least 12 mm maximal diameter. For lymph node metastases, [AND] the largest diameter should be at least 15 mm and the short axis at least 12 mm.
